action.new_text:
# Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Validate input arrays
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_w = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_w = raw_w / raw_w.sum()

    # Weighted sums of log probabilities
    weighted_with = logp_with_result @ norm_w
    weighted_call_only = logp_call_only @ norm_w
    # logp_no_call is provided but not used in the paper's filter

    # Compute margin: improvement of with_result over call_only
    margin = weighted_with - weighted_call_only
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep.astype(np.bool_), margin.astype(np.float64)
